native_fills.engine: csharp; fountain/transparency/shadow stay on the C# path in hybrid mode (VBA row codec barrier)
observed_behavior: IVGFountainColors.Item is 0-based (valid indices 0..Count-1), unlike the 1-based IVGShapes collection; Add(Color, Position) stop positions round-trip exactly
multi-stop fountains read back blend_type=custom regardless of the requested blend; 2-stop fountains keep the requested blend (direct)

Corel renormalizes EdgePad for linear and square fountains with nonzero angle from the rotated gradient axis: linear 0->15 and 20->29 at 45deg, 7->19 at 30deg on a 40x20mm rectangle; square 20->29 at 45deg; angle 0 round-trips exactly (20->20); conical is unaffected
IVGTransparency.AppliedTo/MergeMode exist only after Apply* (COM error when set before apply); property order Apply -> AppliedTo/MergeMode -> Freeze

drop shadow does not wrap the target: the target keeps StaticID/type/geometry, the cdrDropShadow effect attaches to the target, and a sibling cdrDropShadowGroupShape (shadow group with exactly one shadow child) is created; id_mappings = {source_static_id, result_static_ids:[target, group, child]}; removal returns [target]
typed shadow removal is IVGShape.ClearEffect(cdrDropShadow); IVGEffect.Clear() was probed live as an equivalent alternative and is not used by the worker
perspective 0/0 round-trips exactly (v1 does not expose perspective fields); fade round-trips even on flat although the schema forbids fade+flat
center_offset_x/center_offset_y are object-size percents passed through without unit conversion; verified by read-back of 20/-30 in mm and inch documents
fountain/transparency/shadow stay on the C# path in hybrid mode above and below the VBA batch threshold; the VBA row codec never sees fountain fills
